component.name: Sonic Colors - Recompiled
component.summary: Native PC recompilation of Sonic Colors (Wii)

description.p: Sonic Colors Recomp runs the original Wii game as a native PC application (recompilation), with a launcher, settings, music replacement, and mod support. You must supply your own legally obtained Europe / PAL (SNCP8P) game data.
Works with RecompLauncher Easy Setup, optional update downloads and Install & relaunch, save backups, FPS overlay, shader-cache recovery, and diagnostic reports for troubleshooting.
Hotfix: Windows auto-update install after download, and Music Library catalog.json shipped in redistributables.
Hotfix: launcher tabs respond to mouse clicks again after boot (forceTab no longer stuck).
Launcher and updater polish: last played, reinstall confirm, Install & relaunch, verify-data CLI, window size restore, and RecompLauncher settings.
RecompLauncher Easy Setup support and redistributable packages.
